name: Shiretoko
description: National park (1964) on the Shiretoko Peninsula in eastern Hokkaido — drift ice, brown bears, Steller's sea eagles, waterfalls and primeval forest. The peninsula was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site (2005) for its natural value.
highlights: Drift ice and Shiretoko Five Lakes
Brown bears and Steller's sea eagles
reservation: Not required (guided access to the Shiretoko Five Lakes in bear season)
parking: Parking at Utoro, Rausu and major trailheads
notes: Designated 1964 (38,954 ha). Entry to the Five Lakes area is guided in bear season; the Utoro visitor center is the gateway.
